CustomField.description: Flags lines as potentially eligible for Belden S&D when they meet Belden item classification criteria or have Vendor = Belden (31396), for completed lines with cost > 0. Used by teams across the organization to identify items for Belden S&D. If a line is determined not eligible, users can manually check the S_D_Not_Eligible__c field, causing this value to evaluate to false and remove the line from reporting.
CustomField.formula:
AND
(OR(BEGINS(Item_Class_Description__c,'BELDE'), Class__c = 'BE',Class__c = 'BL', Item_Class__c = 'NE912',
Vendor_Number__c = '31396'),
ISPICKVAL(Line_Status__c, 'Complete'), S_D_Not_Eligible__c = False, Line_Cost__c > 0)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indicates whether a line is potentially eligible for Belden S&D based on item classification or vendor. To exclude a line, manually check the S&D Not Eligible field, which will set this value to false and remove the line from reporting.
CustomField.label: Belden S&D Eligible Line Item?
